announcements.headline: Directorate change
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates a change in the board composition, which is a standard governance update. Such changes typically have a neutral to moderate impact on shareholders unless they signal a significant shift in leadership or strategy.

announcements.headline: Trading Update
announcements.insight: A trading update provides shareholders with an interim assessment of the company's performance but lacks directional clarity from the headline alone.

announcements.headline: Trading Update
announcements.insight: This announcement provides a general update on the company's trading performance, but the headline does not indicate whether the results are positive or negative. Shareholders should await the full text to understand the direction of the business and any implications for future guidance.

announcements.headline: Interim Results
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled interim financial results, which provide shareholders with an update on the company's performance for the first half of the financial year.

announcements.headline: Grant of Options & PDMR Dealing
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates that a person discharging managerial responsibilities has engaged in share dealing and/or received options, which is a routine governance disclosure. It provides limited insight into future performance or strategic direction for shareholders.
